description: This file defines the GenericValue class, a core component in the OFBiz framework that handles persistence for any defined entity. It includes methods for creating, storing, removing, and retrieving related entities, as well as other utility functions.

classes.name: GenericValue
classes.description: A versatile class managing entity persistence, including CRUD operations and relationship management within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: NullGenericValue
classes.description: A singleton subclass representing a null or empty entity value.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Static factory methods to instantiate new GenericValue objects with various initial parameters.

methods.name: store
methods.description: Persists the current GenericValue to the data store.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the current GenericValue from the data store.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes the current object state from the persistent store.

methods.name: refreshFromCache
methods.description: Refreshes the current object state from the cache.

methods.name: getRelated
methods.description: Retrieves related entities based on relationship name and optional filtering and ordering.

methods.name: getRelatedOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single related entity based on relationship name.

methods.name: getRelatedDummyPK
methods.description: Obtains a dummy primary key for related entities, possibly incomplete.
